author: ABMN Staff
title: ELCO Management Co. LLC Has $2.94 Million Stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
ELCO Management Co. LLC increased its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 4.8% in the second its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The firm owned 15,885 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 727 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises about 1.6% of ELCO Management Co. LLC’s holdings, making the stock its 20th biggest holding. ELCO Management Co. LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $2,940,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Several other hedge funds have also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the company. B. Riley Financial Inc. lifted its position in Apple by 27.6% during the first quarter. B. Riley Financial Inc. now owns 17,412 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,921,000 after purchasing an additional 3,770 shares during the last quarter. Roof Advisory Group Inc. lifted its position in Apple by 44.0% during the first quarter. Roof Advisory Group Inc. now owns 42,322 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $7,101,000 after purchasing an additional 12,930 shares during the last quarter. Mizuho Securities USA LLC bought a new stake in Apple during the first quarter valued at approximately $1,477,000. Viridian Ria LLC bought a new stake in Apple during the first quarter valued at approximately $525,000. Finally, Turim 21 Investimentos Ltda. lifted its position in Apple by 5.1% during the first quarter. Turim 21 Investimentos Ltda. now owns 59,421 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,970,000 after purchasing an additional 2,906 shares during the last quarter.
